limitations: Each capture is asynchronous and historical tooltips were acquired later than initial quote.
Quote/book quantities and OHLCV volume suffixes are rendered precision only; no exact unrounded depth asserted.

UI chart interval selection is preserved but event UTC, candle boundary semantics and finality are not independently verified. Sampled historical bars are not asserted to be the most recent closed bars.
Hourly OI quantity labels are preserved separately from notional USD OI; missing intermediate endpoints must not be interpolated.
Settled funding rows are a separate capture, not current predicted funding. Settlement event UTC remains unknown.
No trading eligibility, fill, account balance or position is inferred.

numeric_conventions.volume_suffixes: K=1,000; M=1,000,000; B=1,000,000,000; rendered values are rounded.
